passage.title: The Little Lost Puppy
passage.text: One sunny afternoon, a fluffy brown puppy named Max wandered away from his yard into the busy neighborhood park. Max sniffed the green grass and chased a bright yellow butterfly, but soon he realized he was all alone and did not know the way back. Panicked, Max began to whimper softly while searching under every park bench. Suddenly, his owner Leo called out his name from across the playground. Max perked up his floppy ears, barked with joy, and ran straight into Leo's open arms.
passage.author: Teacher Sarah
